TICKET
# One Click Upgrade 4.15.0.: It's not possible to create a PHP session and no new version available.

When you update the One Click Upgrade module to 4.15.0 on (At least Prestashop version 1.7.8.8) we get an error that it's not possible to create a PHP session.
This happends on multiple shops and we have no clue what is wrong. The module also doesn't see Prestashop 8.0.0

https://watch.screencastify.com/v/Nh8ObM9wUOgHlhgjgPnN

## Attendu
It should open a PHP connection.

## Étapes
1. Module list
2. Upgrade One Click Upgrade to 4.15.0
3. Configure the module
4. See the PHP connection error

This latest version adds this type of error which prevents the use of the module to update prestashop. Without this change in the plesk it would not be possible to update.
From what I know the problem is on all websites using plesk of every hosting, but with cpanel I have no problems.
